name: english-coach-web
comment:kit: The component kit is built separately from the app: `npm run build:kit` emits dist-kit/, which is what design tooling imports. The app itself is never installed as a package.

scripts.build:kit: rm -rf dist-kit && tsc -p tsconfig.kit.json && vite build -c vite.config.kit.ts
scripts.build: npm run sync-content && tsc --noEmit && vite build

comment: No @vitejs/plugin-react on purpose: its babel/browserslist chain wants caniuse builds the registry does not serve, and Vite compiles JSX with esbuild anyway. The cost is no Fast Refresh in dev.
